title: Chiral Vector Lensing: Reproducibility Code and Numerical Data
description: Public calculation and numerical-data companion for Parity-Odd Weak Lensing from Chiral Vector Dark Matter. Includes the deterministic AEN handoff, relativistic current quadrature, corrected nonlinear axion-Proca pilot, validation histories, tests, post-processing and figure generation.
